services.title: KnownFix Evidence Audit: Focused
services.tagline: A rigorous, bounded review of the design, trust, SEO/AEO, performance, and conversion evidence that matters first.
services.scope: One public website: the homepage plus up to four key journey pages.

Desktop and mobile design, UX, and trust review
Offer, copy, and conversion-path review
Technical SEO, AEO/GEO, structured-data, and social-preview checks

Evidence tied to exact pages and reproducible observations
A practical 14-day improvement plan

services.title: Evidence-Led Homepage Build

deliverables: Evidence brief covering audience, offer, conversion path, trust signals, and current-site constraints
Homepage information architecture and conversion-focused copy
High-fidelity responsive visual design tailored to the brand and product
Production-ready homepage source included in the private delivery
Technical SEO, answer-engine metadata, and accurate structured-data recommendations
Desktop and mobile browser QA with accessibility and performance checks
Implementation notes, verification evidence, and a prioritized launch checklist

Existing public assets may be reused only where the buyer has authority. No ranking, traffic, revenue, or conversion outcome is guaranteed.

services.title: Codebase Review
services.tagline: A senior-engineering review focused on defects, security boundaries, maintainability, tests, and release risk.
services.scope: One public GitHub repository up to 50,000 source lines. Larger or private repositories require a scoped quote.
deliverables: Findings ordered by severity with file and line references
Correctness, security, dependency, and data-boundary review
Architecture and maintainability assessment
Test, CI, and release-gap analysis
Prioritized remediation plan
Plain-language executive summary
services.limitations: This is a bounded review, not a guarantee that every defect or vulnerability will be found. Only public repository content is accepted through this checkout.

services.title: Agent Commerce Audit
services.tagline: Can an AI agent discover, understand, trust, buy from, and successfully use your service?
services.scope: One public agent-facing service, API, MCP server, or paid endpoint.
deliverables: Agent discovery and crawlability review
llms.txt, schema, OpenAPI, MCP, and capability-contract checks
Offer, checkout, x402, and payment-proof review where present
Buyer-journey test from first request through fulfillment
Trust, provenance, privacy, and failure-mode findings
Prioritized agent-readiness remediation plan

services.title: Release Pipeline Review
services.tagline: A focused review of CI, publishing, provenance, secrets, and rollback readiness before the next release hurts.
services.scope: One public GitHub repository and its checked-in CI/release configuration.
deliverables: GitHub Actions and release-flow findings
Permissions, secrets, and token-boundary review
Dependency and package-publishing risk review
Versioning, provenance, rollback, and recovery assessment
Prioritized fixes with verification steps
services.limitations: The review covers checked-in configuration and public workflow evidence. Private logs, organization settings, registries, and signing systems are outside scope unless separately authorized.

services.title: Webhook Reliability Review
services.tagline: An evidence-first source review of webhook verification, duplicate handling, retries and processing boundaries.
services.scope: One public GitHub repository, one webhook integration and up to three event-processing paths, capped at 10,000 relevant source lines. Read-only review of checked-in code, tests and configuration.
deliverables: Delivery-to-processing flow map for the scoped integration
Signature verification and acceptance-boundary findings with file and line references
Duplicate handling, idempotency, ordering and retry review
Queue failure, recovery and observability gap analysis
Prioritized fixes with focused regression-test recommendations
Self-contained HTML report plus SHA-256-verified Markdown source
services.limitations: This is a bounded source review, not live incident response, a penetration test or a guarantee that all defects will be found. Private repositories, provider dashboards, signing keys, customer payloads, production access, event replays, deployment and implementation are excluded. No payment or business event is triggered. The three-business-day delivery target starts after confirmed payment and a complete, in-scope public repository brief.

services.title: SaaS Security Exposure Review
services.tagline: A bounded, explicitly authorized review of exposed services, login flows and application access boundaries.
services.scope: One owner-authorized SaaS application and up to five agreed endpoints or flows. Prefer staging and owner-provided test accounts; public exposure observations are limited to an exact approved target allowlist.
deliverables: Scope and authorization receipt with exact targets, permitted methods and stop conditions
Bounded exposed database, storage and admin-interface observations without accessing customer records
Login, password-reset and session-handling findings within agreed test flows
Authorization and cross-account isolation checks using approved test accounts only
Severity-ranked evidence, safe reproduction steps and prioritized remediation recommendations
Self-contained HTML report plus SHA-256-verified Markdown source
services.limitations: Written ownership or authorized-representative confirmation and explicit testing permission are required before work. Agree the exact host and endpoint allowlist, permitted methods, test accounts, test window, request limits, exclusions, emergency contact and stop conditions in advance; a public URL or checkbox is not permission. Obtain any required third-party provider permission. No destructive testing, broad or bulk scanning, denial of service, credential guessing, persistence, customer-data extraction, production account takeover or third-party systems. Stop on unexpected sensitive data or out-of-scope access. This is a bounded review, not a comprehensive penetration test, compliance certification or security guarantee; implementation and remediation are excluded. Request scope approval before arranging payment; automated checkout is unavailable for this service. The five-business-day delivery target starts only after written scope approval, confirmed payment and required test access.
